name: retro
description: Team retrospective from the enforced audit trail: git history + protocol logs turned into a human-readable report with metrics and week-over-week trends. Branchless (per-run r-retro-<date> task with frontmatter branch: none); artifacts land uncommitted in docs/retros/. Example: protocol_start(protocol_name="retro") at the end of a work week to generate the weekly team retro and trend snapshot.

steps.name: data-collection
steps.description: Stale-anchor pre-flight, typed data aggregation, scope confirmation, retro task creation
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] retro_collect_data reported guard: "passed" — on "blocked": recoverable=false → explain and protocol_abort; recoverable=true (window-dependent reasons only) → abort OR, with explicit user approval, proceed with a wider retro_window_days in the task file (the structural gate re-validates). Never work around the guard by other means.
- [ ] The user has confirmed the retro scope (window, authors, data preview).
- [ ] Retro task file written WRITE-FILE-FIRST to team-management/tasks/r-retro-<date>.md (frontmatter branch: none, optional retro_window_days), then advance with args: {"task": "r-retro-<date>", "task_content": ""} using the engine-supplied suggested_task_name.

steps.name: metrics
steps.description: Deterministic engine-computed metrics and week-over-week deltas, reviewed with the user
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] The engine-computed metrics and deltas from retro_compute_metrics have been presented to the user (engine numbers are authoritative — never recompute or adjust them).
- [ ] The user has confirmed the metrics look plausible or anomalies were discussed.

steps.name: narrative
steps.description: Write the retro report (praise, growth opportunity, habits, trends) to docs/retros/
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] The narrative report exists at docs/retros/retro-<date>.md with all required sections: ## Praise, ## Growth Opportunity, ## Habits, ## Trends.
- [ ] Praises cite real commit SHAs from the metrics payload; exactly ONE growth opportunity framed as an investment; exactly 3 habits, each adoptable in under 5 minutes.
On advance the engine credential-filters the report in place, verifies the required sections, and writes the JSON snapshot — retro_finalize_snapshot blocks the advance on any failure.

steps.name: snapshot
steps.description: Review the snapshot and trends, confirm completion, archive the retro task
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] The user has reviewed the report and snapshot and explicitly confirmed the retro is complete.
On advance the engine automatically archives the retro task and cleans up task-scoped state. Retro artifacts (report, snapshot, archived task) are left UNCOMMITTED for the user to review and commit.
